sources.observation: Official GLA sorts sampled curve coordinates separately, clips scale to 0.9..1.1 and clips location according to input percentiles; controlled implementation sorts control-point coordinates and specifies different truncated distributions.
Notebook blob identity recorded; paper equation samples an unconstrained Gaussian multiplier, whereas controlled implementation clips negative multipliers.

Official waves are unit L2-normalized and then multiplied by image_size/32; frequencies and orientations are sampled on discrete grids. Controlled implementation uses a continuous grid and a chosen pixel-RMS mean of 0.05.
Published implementation uses a discrete Butterworth filter bank and offline masks; controlled implementation specifies continuous per-channel filter samples and radial masks.
